caption: The image depicts a square object resembling a woven carpet or textile, placed centrally on a light beige background. The textile has a predominantly red background with intricate blue designs woven throughout. The design consists of repeating horizontal bands containing motifs of buildings with pointed roofs, trees, and what appear to be water or wavy lines beneath the structures. These motifs are arranged symmetrically in rows, filling the surface of the textile. The border of the textile features a narrower band with repeating geometric and plant-like patterns in the same red and blue color scheme. The edges of the textile show a slight fringe, and the textile appears to have fine detail throughout the composition. The background paper is bordered with a simple rectangular line, and there is minimal handwriting in the bottom right corner.
title: Coverlet
